description: This file defines a React component 'EmojiManager' which manages emoji items, including functionalities for loading emojis from an API, filtering/searching, adding new emojis via upload, and deleting existing emojis. It also includes UI elements such as modals, search input, and emoji grid.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw emoji data from the API into a consistent structure tailored for UI rendering.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a usage count seed for each emoji based on its identifier.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures that the counts state reflects the current list of emojis, adding new counts and removing obsolete ones.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches emoji data from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Prepares and displays the modal for adding a new emoji.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the add emoji modal, respecting loading states.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the upload process for a new emoji, including validation, API call, and updating the list.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Deletes an emoji via the API and refreshes the list.
